title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Numbers 1: the census of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai, the princes of the tribes, and the special task of the Levites.

questions.text: When did Yahweh tell Moses to take the census?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of Egypt.

answers.text: On the tenth day of the first month, in the first year
On the first day of the seventh month, in the third year
On the first day of the second month, in the second year
On the fourteenth day of the first month, in the second year

questions.text: Which males were to be counted?
questions.explanation: They were to count every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war.

answers.text: Those twenty years old and upward who could go to war
Those thirty years old and upward who could serve
Every male from a month old and upward
Only the firstborn of every family

questions.text: Who was to stand with Moses and Aaron for the census?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers' house, was to be with them.

answers.text: The seventy elders of Israel and their officers
The priests Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron
The judges of every city in Israel
A man from every tribe, the head of his fathers' house

questions.text: Who was the man named for the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 names Nahshon the son of Amminadab for Judah.

answers.text: Elizur the son of Shedeur
Nahshon the son of Amminadab
Eliab the son of Helon
Abidan the son of Gideoni

questions.text: Which tribe is called "Israel's firstborn" in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 speaks of the children of Reuben, Israel's firstborn.

answers.text: Judah
Levi
Ephraim
Reuben

questions.text: How many were counted of the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says those counted of the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

answers.text: Fifty-nine thousand three hundred
Sixty-two thousand seven hundred
Seventy-four thousand six hundred
Forty-six thousand five hundred

questions.text: What was the total of all who were counted?
questions.explanation: Verse 46 says all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

answers.text: Six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty
Six hundred thousand exactly
Five hundred ninety-eight thousand
Six hundred twenty-two thousand

questions.text: Which tribe was not counted among the others?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses not to count the tribe of Levi or take a census of them among the children of Israel.

answers.text: Dan
Levi
Benjamin
Manasseh

questions.text: Over what were the Levites appointed?
questions.explanation: Verse 50 says the Levites were appointed over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, its furnishings and all that belongs to it.

answers.text: The army of Israel and its captains
The standards and banners of the tribes
The Tabernacle of the Testimony and its furnishings
The storehouses of grain and oil

questions.text: What would happen to a stranger who came near when the tabernacle was taken down or set up?
questions.explanation: The Levites were to take down and set up the tabernacle, and the stranger who came near was to be put to death.

answers.text: He would be put to death
He would be unclean until evening
He would have to bring a sin offering
He would be put out of the camp for seven days
